title: CaptureEvent
description: A single normalized UI event produced by the vision pipeline or emitted directly by the sandbox app (ground-truth). One event per screen state change.

t.description: Seconds since session start (monotonic, fractional allowed).

object.description: The entity the event refers to, e.g. "Customer: Acme / MSA Amendment 2".

field.description: Form field name for value/field events, e.g. "ARR input".

from.description: Previous value before the change (number for money/counts, string otherwise).

evidence_frame.description: Frame id that evidences this event, e.g. "f_0192".

salient_text.description: Literal on-screen text the vision model read, used to anchor questions to what is visible.

confidence.description: Model confidence for vision-derived events, 0..1. Null/1.0 for app-emitted ground-truth events.

source.description: Which pipeline produced the event. "vision" = primary source per the brief; "app" = ground-truth fallback, never shown to the agent.
